title: ResolutionSectionClassZeroAugmentation
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes, $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, $I$ an injective resolution of $F$, $V\subseteq Y$ open, and $U=f^{-1}V$. Let $R$ be RestrictedResolutionSections $I,U$ of [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], including the augmentation-preserving resolution comparison and pinned section components. For every $s\in\Gamma(U,F|_U)$, apply the canonical degree-zero global-sections augmentation [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology], then resolutionSectionClass for $R$ and $f_*I$, then the inverse resolution comparison into $R^0f_*F$. The result in $(R^0f_*F)(V)$ equals the canonical direct-image augmentation of the section of $F(U)$ corresponding to $s$ by restrictAppIso followed by the inclusion-image-top equality.

proof.text: For any short complex and a homology-preserving functor, derive compatibility of mapHomologyIso with the cycles-to-homology projection from the left homology data. For a left exact right adjoint and a natural-number complex, the incoming degree-zero differential vanishes. Apply adjunction naturality and the triangle identity to show that the adjoint of the exact left-adjoint homology comparison followed by the counit equals the right-adjoint degree-zero homology comparison. Specialize this proved private calculation to sheafification and forgetful functors to identify sectionCohomologyTheta in degree zero.

Evaluate R.augmentation at the whole restricted open and substitute R.components at zero. Naturality of the original augmentation for the inclusion-image-top equality gives equality of the two section maps into degree-zero resolution terms. Cancel the monic evaluated cycles inclusion and use naturality of the cycles-to-homology projection to transport this equality through the three homology comparisons. These are proved private categorical helpers, not new assumptions.

Expand the source degree-zero augmentation using InjectiveResolution.toRightDerivedZero_eq and cancel its inverse resolution comparison against the hom comparison in resolutionSectionClass. Expand the direct-image augmentation by the same formula. Substitute the degree-zero theta identity and the homology transport equality, append the inverse target resolution comparison, and evaluate the resulting morphism equality on s.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01E4 (lemma-describe-higher-direct-images), online tag page read; explicit Lean degree-zero calculation using kernel functoriality, adjunction triangle identity and Mathlib RightDerived.lean.

theorem resolutionSectionClass_zero_augmentation {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (F : X.Modules) (I : InjectiveResolution F) (V : Y.Opens)
    (R : RestrictedResolutionSections I (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))
    (s : ((restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) :
    (resolutionSectionClass R.resolution
      (((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)
      V R.sections 0 ≫ Hom.app (I.isoRightDerivedObj (pushforward f) 0).inv V)
        (((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor
          (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace).toRightDerivedZero.app
            ((restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F)).hom s) =
    (Hom.app
      ((pushforward f).toRightDerivedZero.app F) V)
        (F.presheaf.map (eqToHom (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι_image_top.symm).op
          ((F.restrictAppIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ⊤).hom s))
